prompt_palette_prompt_state.source_text: Wide establishing shot inside a small neighborhood bakery just before opening. Warm sunrise spills through the front windows. A baker carries a tray of fresh bread from the oven, places it on the counter, tears one loaf open and steam rises. The camera slowly dollies from the doorway to a medium shot at the counter. Flour floats in the light. Audio: oven fan, tray on wood, crust crackle, distant street traffic, no music.

label_pal_v1.title: AUDIO + VIDEO TIP · Directing Sound
label_pal_v1.note:
- Describe shot framing, subject action, and camera movement first, then end with an explicit `Audio:` line.
- Specify ``no music`` or concrete foley cues (`crust crackle, distant traffic`) for clean diegetic sound.
